submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured along the In–Sb line, the Sb-rich film (In0.20Sb0.80) gave the highest EQE (0.0192%). It was slightly ahead of the near-1:1 InSbO4 composition (0.0174%), and the In-rich film was clearly lower (0.0057%). The merit budget is used up.

rejected.reason: Near-stoichiometric InSbO4; its EQE of 0.0174% is a little below index 24.
